main.description: Where one reader is in a book read along with others: one per reader in their own repo inside the book's space (type at.stim.reading.readAlong), never in a public repo. Spoiler-free on purpose: a chapter number and a percentage, no chapter titles or text.

percent.description: How far through the reader's own copy, rounded down.

chapter.description: The chapter the reader is in, counted in their own copy's table of contents. Absent when the copy has none (often a PDF).

finished.description: Marked as finished in the reader, or on the last page.

index.description: 1-based position in the table of contents.

count.description: Chapters in that table of contents.
